title: Minimum Cost for Cutting Cake II
summary: Given an m x n cake, determine the minimum total cost to cut it into 1 x 1 pieces.
statement: Given an m x n cake, determine the minimum total cost to cut it into 1 x 1 pieces. The costs for horizontal cuts are provided in the array horizontalCut, where horizontalCut[i] represents the cost to cut along the horizontal line i. Similarly, the costs for vertical cuts are provided in the array verticalCut, where verticalCut[j] represents the cost to cut along the vertical line j. Each cut divides a piece of cake into two distinct pieces, and the cost of each cut remains constant regardless of the number of divisions.
constraints: horizontalCut and verticalCut have lengths m-1 and n-1 and may be large.
Each listed line must cut every current piece it crosses, paying its fixed cost for each piece.
Return the minimum total cost to create 1x1 pieces using the scalable greedy strategy.
reference_solution:
def minimum_cake_cut_cost_greedy(m,n,horizontalCut,verticalCut):
    cuts=sorted([(cost,0) for cost in horizontalCut]+[(cost,1) for cost in verticalCut],reverse=True);pieces=[1,1];answer=0
    for cost,direction in cuts:answer+=cost*pieces[1-direction];pieces[direction]+=1
    return answer
